fieldNotes.intersex: Not given below national/county level in Table 2.4 (footnote). County intersex = 13 from Table 2.2.
fieldNotes.households: Total households = conventional + group quarters; both components also given.
fieldNotes.density: Persons per sq km as printed.
fieldNotes.names: Names as printed by KNBS (upper case). Several divisions/locations/sub-locations share names (e.g. NYAMIRA, MANGA, KEMERA); use the full path.

checks: 113 sub-locations in 49 locations, 14 divisions, 5 sub-counties. Hierarchy rebuilt by nesting on totals (each parent total equals the sum of its children, at every level) and confirmed against the printed indentation (no conflicts). Sub-location totals, male, female, households (total, conventional, group quarters) sum exactly to every printed sub-county, division and location figure and to the county row (county total 605576 = sum 605576). Differences found: (1) Land area: sums of sub-location areas differ from printed parent areas by +/-0.1 sq km in 13 cases (rounding to one decimal), e.g. Nyamira South printed 181.5 vs sum 181.6; no sub-county difference beyond 0.1. (2) Total minus (male+female) is 1-2 persons in some rows; the table footnote says intersex figures are too few to distribute below national level, so totals include intersex persons not shown by sex. At county level the gap is 13, which equals the Nyamira intersex count in Table 2.2 (pdf p.22, printed p.11). Sub-county gaps: Borabu 0, Manga 2, Masaba North 2, Nyamira North 6, Nyamira South 3. (3) All five sub-county rows in Table 2.4 match Table 2.3 (pdf p.31, printed p.20) exactly; Table 2.3 prints area rounded to whole sq km (Manga 111.5 in Table 2.4 is printed 111 in Table 2.3, consistent with an unrounded value just under 111.5). Table 2.4 has no intersex column, so intersex is null for every row. Full list of rounding/sex-gap findings: see issues.
